verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Seer, its AI debugging agent, which 'automatically root-cause[s] any issue', and Autofix, which finds root causes and generates suggested code fixes. The resulting root cause analysis is actionable: it can be handed to coding agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for fix generation and pull request creation. Seer requires a paid subscription. Missing for 10: documentation that Seer's analysis specifically draws on stack traces, breadcrumbs and related or suspect commits; detail on how the analysis works; independent or hands-on confirmation of root-cause quality.
